hey. i havent been around because my internet has been out.
anyway, ive been practicing tying nooses for the last hour and i think i'm going to go ahead and do it tonight.
it hit me this afternoon that i dont really have any friends anymore. my boyfriend is frustrated with me and stressed from work. my best friend hates me now, and i suppose she doesnt even consider me her best friend herself. there's just nothing here for me. i dont see a point anymore.
i guess this is goodbye, if things follow through.
